recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser survival arcade game called **Haddonfield Last Light: Slasher Survival**. Preserve a top-down roam-and-survive loop with joystick/keyboard movement, a grab action for nearby tools, a strike action using a forward attack cone, slow pursuing enemies that damage on contact, score gained by defeating enemies, three health pips, a persistent collection index, and restartable game-over flow. Present the experience as Halloween slasher survival in suburban autumn: a final survivor stalked by silent pale-mask figures, leaf-strewn streets, porch lights, jack-o-lanterns, improvised tools, tense dread, and mobile-readable HUD language.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Top-down mobile survival arcade with free-roam movement, collectibles, enemy chase pressure, attack arcs, health depletion, and restartable runs.
- objective: Move through a large wrapped play space, collect usable tools, defeat pursuing enemies for score, and survive until three health pips are exhausted.
- input model: Keyboard on desktop plus portrait-first touch joystick for movement and two action buttons for grab and attack.
- core loop: Start run, spawn player with nearby collectible tools and enemies, move camera-centered avatar, grab a nearby tool, strike enemies inside a forward arc, gain score from defeated enemies, suffer contact damage, continue spawning enemies/tools, restart after defeat.
- fail/friction state: Contact with enemies removes one of three hearts with short invulnerability; at zero hearts a modal game-over state reports final score and offers restart/menu.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve free-roam player acceleration, friction, world bounds, camera follow, and mobile joystick semantics.
- Preserve separate grab and attack actions, pickup radius, held-tool replacement, attack cooldown/reach/damage, and forward cone hit testing.
- Preserve enemy edge spawning, slow pursuit, contact damage, knockback, health scaling, score on defeat, and occasional tool drop on enemy defeat.
- Preserve three-heart loss model, final-score modal, restart/menu flow, persistent collection index, and portrait touch actionability.

## Remixed target
Haddonfield Last Light reframes the same survival chase as a Halloween slasher night: the player is the final survivor moving through autumn suburbia, enemies are silent pale-mask stalkers, collectibles are improvised survival tools, score is Nerve, hearts are Last Lights, and failure is The Shape finding the survivor. Mechanics remain intact while scene ownership, HUD language, procedural silhouettes, fonts, colors, and feedback become suburban autumn dread.
